description: Mark an issued or sent invoice as Paid. Optionally record the paid amount and payment date. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

invoice_id.description: Id of the invoice to mark as paid.

paid_date.description: Optional payment date (ISO 8601). Defaults to today.

name: mark_invoice_paid
